transcript:
Header: 
Date: 2025-09-15 10:00 AM PT
Duration: ~52 minutes
Attendees: Sofia Alvarez, Mark Tran, Priya Nair, Jason Lee, Emily Carter, Devon Morgan, Lena Ortiz

Summary: Internal planning call for the Sept webinar: finalize run-of-show, confirm speakers, lock landing page and email flows, set paid promo budget and rehearsal date.

---

[00:00] Sofia: Okay, hey everyone, thanks for joining, um it's 10am so we'll kick off. quick agenda: run-of-show, speakers, landing page, emails, paid ads, rehearsal. if we can walk through each and call out owners that'd be great.
[00:22] Mark: Sounds good. I'll start with run-of-show. so opening remarks 5 minutes, product demo 15, customer panel 20, q&a 10, wrap 2, buffer 8. that's the rough. We still need to decide who does the demo, um is that going to be Raj or Lina?
[00:42] Priya: I thought Raj said he could do it but he might be on travel the week before. Lina's been deep in the project so she'd be good. also we need speaker bios, short blurbs for the landing page.
[01:05] Jason: For KPIs, we're targeting 1,200 registrations, 400 attend, 50 MQLs. paid budget initially $4k to start, can flex after week one. targeting: dev + ML engs at midmarket and up, EMEA + NA focus.
[01:28] Emily: PR wants a one-sheet to push to community channels and partner blogs. will need speaker headshots high res.
[01:40] Mark: Right. Sponsors — Lena, any updates on potential sponsor mentions?
[01:48] Lena: We have verbal interest from VectorSigma — not locked. We should keep sponsor slot at the top right after intro, 2 minutes. also need logo placement on landing page.
[02:05] Sofia: Ok we'll keep sponsor slot at 2 minutes. Mark, can you add sponsor mention to the run-of-show?
[02:12] Mark: Yep I'll update and share.
[02:18] Priya: About the landing page, I built a draft in Webflow staging. it's got headline, webinar summary, speakers, and a form. I didn't wire the thank-you gated asset flow yet — we'll want a one-pager or recording clip as a gated download.
[02:36] Sofia: Gated asset idea: 1-pager with summary and key takeaways + checklist for inference readiness. that pairs well with Redwood Optimize messaging.
[02:48] Jason: For email cadence, I propose: initial invite, reminder 3 days before, day-of reminder, and follow-up with recording and gated asset. we should A/B test subject lines and the hero image. Priya can do two variants of copy.
[03:10] Priya: Yep, I can do two variants. I'll focus variant A on technical outcomes and variant B on business impact and cost savings.
[03:20] Devon: Quick ops note — we need to confirm which Zoom account or webinar platform. Zoom Webinars is easiest but ON24 gives more analytics. budget might be a deciding factor.
[03:33] Jason: Right. my recommendation is Zoom Webinars for ease, unless sponsor requires ON24. we can instrument UTM and tracking ourselves.
[03:43] Mark: Any preference on length of customer panel? 20 felt right but worried it may run long with Q&A.
[03:50] Sofia: Maybe 15 for panel + 12 for q&a. that keeps total under an hour.
[03:57] Mark: ok 15 + 12 then.
[04:02] Emily: PR asks if we can record and provide b-roll snippets for media outreach.
[04:09] Sofia: yes, we'll record. Mark can handle recording permissions and getting raw clip.
[04:15] Mark: noted. I'll confirm recording settings.
[04:20] Sofia: Dry run — we should schedule one week before. I'm thinking 2025-09-24 10am PT. everyone?
[04:27] Jason: Works for me.
[04:29] Priya: Works.
[04:31] Devon: Works.
[04:33] Lena: Works.
[04:35] Sofia: ok lock that in.
[04:38] Priya: Quick question on registration form fields — should we require company size and role to help qualify leads?
[04:46] Jason: Yes require role and company name, optional company size. keep friction low. maybe include dropdown for "primary interest" (cost, latency, private deployment).
[04:55] Priya: Good idea. I'll add that.
[04:58] Mark: For promo channels — LinkedIn, developer forums, partner newsletters, and email to existing lists. Paid social will be LinkedIn + X. budget split 70/30 LinkedIn/X.
[05:12] Jason: we'll track conversions by UTM, and set up a shared spreadsheet. I'll share the UTM sheet by Friday.
[05:19] Emily: Also check with legal about any data residency language on registration.
[05:24] Sofia: Good call, Devon can follow up with Legal.
[05:28] Devon: I'll ping legal, yes.
[05:31] Mark: Any thoughts on speaker prep? we should have slide templates and a 15-min max for demo. and speaker notes for transitions.
[05:41] Priya: I'll make slide templates and share a google slide deck.
[05:44] Sofia: Also let's do mic checks and network check on the dry run. common issues are background noise and screen sharing lag.
[05:53] Jason: On tracking MQLs, define the qualification: attended 25+ minutes + role = yes, or registered + watched recording may be nurture.
[06:05] Sofia: Let's craft the MQL rule in HubSpot with Jason and CSM later.
[06:10] Priya: One more small thing: webinar title. I suggested "Serving LLMs at Scale: Cost, Latency, and Deployments" — too long?
[06:20] Mark: I like it but maybe shorter: "Serving LLMs at Scale: Cost & Latency Tradeoffs"
[06:26] Sofia: Maybe "Serving LLMs at Scale" with a subtitle. we'll A/B test title with social copy.
[06:33] Priya: ok I'll add variants to the copy doc.
[06:36] Emily: PR wants embargo for any product mentions till Oct 1st. check with product?
[06:42] Sofia: Product sign-off is needed. I'll get a brief from research team and confirm.
[06:46] Mark: On logistics, we need speaker confirmations by 09/18 so we can confirm slides and bios.
[06:54] Sofia: agreed. next steps recap: Mark sends run-of-show and speaker confirmations, Priya sends copy variants and slide template, Jason shares UTM & ad plan, Sofia publishes landing page draft and coordinates with Legal/Product, schedule dry run 09/24.
[07:16] Jason: Any budget approvals needed beyond initial $4k? if sponsors bring in offset, we can increase.
[07:24] Lena: I'll follow up with sponsor outreach and confirm if sponsor covers platform cost.
[07:30] Devon: Legal check: registration form terms need to include data processing note. I'll loop Legal.
[07:36] Sofia: Great. thanks everyone. wrap up?
[07:40] Priya: Nothing else.
[07:41] Mark: all good from me.
[07:43] Emily: OK thanks.
[07:45] Sofia: Thanks all — I'll send notes and action items after the call.

End of transcript.

References/Links mentioned: landing page draft (Webflow staging link - private), run-of-show doc (Google Drive - private), UTM spreadsheet (Google Sheets - private), slide template (Google Slides - private).
notes: Recording to be uploaded to internal drive post-webinar
Ensure HubSpot MQL rule is documented
Consider mini case-study asset as gated content
